newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 2.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Communist China eases rules governing news coverage by reporters from Taiwan.
Chairman of Democratic Progressive Party will be elected by all party members.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Two-thirds of people interviewed by a poll say they are satisified with cabinet's performance.
Police target a certain suspect for Taoyuan shooting case.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry will allow a new insurance product to protect businesses' overseas investments.
Taiwan will allow new applications of priate power stations.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Chiang Ping-kun, chairman of the Council for Economic Planning and Development, receives the highest ranking among economic and trade officials from local business leaders.
Taiwan issues a total of T$200 billion government bonds this year, the highest level in four years.
